name: OTS rationalisation and custom-code purge
principle: OTS first; configuration and integration before bespoke code

closure_surface: custom executables invoked by active runtime paths
non_blocking_historical_surface: historical proof code not referenced by active runtime
scope.reason: Historical Git evidence must not be misclassified as a live service. Stage 1 closes on the active and desired estate, while provenance remains preserved.

ots_preference_order: bespoke implementation only with documented gap and owner
closure_requirements: every active service/container/timer has an explicit disposition and distinct responsibility
no active REVIEW_UNIQUE item remains without a documented unique responsibility and maintenance owner
automatic update/restart tooling does not bypass governed change, verification, and rollback policy
protected core services survive every retirement batch
runtime and desired state agree after bounded retirement
fresh live evidence is recorded before status becomes COMPLETE
completion_rule: Do not set COMPLETE from repository classification alone. COMPLETE requires fresh live runtime evidence after all obsolete active components are retired or explicitly justified.
